description: This file contains internal functions and types for compiling Go test suites, managing parallel compilation, and cleanup operations within the Ginkgo testing framework.

classes.name: parallelSuiteBundle
classes.description: Struct used to bundle a TestSuite with a channel for its compiled result.

classes.name: OrderedParallelCompiler
classes.description: Struct managing ordered parallel compilation of test suites with synchronization.

methods.name: CompileSuite
methods.description: Compiles a test suite into a binary, handling errors and skipping if no tests are found.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes compiled test binaries unless preservation is required.

methods.name: NewOrderedParallelCompiler
methods.description: Creates a new instance of OrderedParallelCompiler with specified number of concurrent compilers.

methods.name: StartCompiling
methods.description: Begins parallel compilation of multiple test suites with ordered result collection.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Retrieves the next compiled test suite in order.

methods.name: StopAndDrain
methods.description: Stops the ongoing compilation process safely.
